items.title: Zuckerberg Reaffirms Faith In 'Open Weight' AI. Will It Pay Off For Meta Stock?
items.summary: Meta Platforms Chief Executive Mark Zuckerberg this week stepped back into the ring as a champion for open AI models.  It remains to be seen what that means for Meta stock and the social media giant's expensive push to be an AI leader.  Zuckerberg published more than 6,000 words detailing his view that broad access to AI models is best for the industry's future.

items.title: Meta (META) Deletes 756,000 Teen Accounts, But Is It Enough?
items.summary: Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META) says it has taken down 756,000 accounts it believes belonged to Australians under 16 since a nationwide ban on teen social media use took effect on December 10.
